node.statement: Fourth term. Put U=H_{S,R}(W)X, which lies in M_{n,1} tensor S_{S,Q} by def-ha-map. Then T_4=Z dot U-H_{P,S}(Z)U, so lem-hcb1-column-action gives q_P(T_4)<=C_act*e||Z||q_S(U). Preliminary control (iv) gives q_S(U)<=K||W||q_R(X). Therefore q_P(T_4)<=C_act*K*e||Z||||W||q_R(X). These four estimates establish the parent claim.
